tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: Professor Chen, the instructor of your creative writing class, is organizing a short-story contest for students at your university. He has heard that you have experience organizing a similar event and has asked you for advice on promoting the contest. Write an email to Professor Chen.
bullets: Describe your experience organizing a past campus event.
Provide recommendations on how to attract participants to the short-story contest.
Offer your help and explain what you can do.
tasks.subject: Short-story contest
